# Storage onboarding: kinds catalog, honest refusals, read-only probe, the
# guided local-kind add (auto alias remote + rollback), root-level remote
# kinds without --remote-path, credential-file discipline and remote_exists.
mkdir remote-files
mkdir local
exec sh -c 'printf hello > remote-files/a.txt'
exec sh -c 'printf "[nas]\ntype = alias\nremote = %s\n" "$1" > rclone.conf' sh $WORK/remote-files
chmod 0600 rclone.conf

# The catalog lists every kind with honest generic capabilities,
# plus additive tier/bind_default discovery fields.
exec drivebridge storage kinds --json
stdout '"command":"drivebridge.storage.kinds"'
stdout '"kind":"openlist"'
stdout '"direct_url":false'
stdout '"tier":"first_class_store"'
stdout '"bind_default":true'
stdout '"bind_default_kinds"'
stdout '"kind":"alias"'

# Unknown kinds and missing flags fail with pointers, not guesses; the
# failure envelope carries the storage-add command identity.
! exec drivebridge storage add --kind dropmark --space x --local-root $WORK/local --json
stdout 'storage_kind_unknown'
! exec drivebridge --state $WORK/state --rclone-config $WORK/rclone.conf storage add --kind openlist --space x --local-root $WORK/local --json
stdout 'storage_missing_flag'
stdout '"command":"drivebridge.storage-add"'

# Legacy space add failures carry the same identity as its success envelope.
! exec drivebridge --state $WORK/state --rclone-config $WORK/rclone.conf space add --space dup --remote nas --backend generic --local-root $WORK/relative --max-bytes 1048576 --json
stdout '"command":"drivebridge.space-add"'

# Probe is read-only: unknown remote fails (machine envelope on stdout),
# alias remote lists; the failure envelope names storage.probe.
! exec drivebridge --rclone-config $WORK/rclone.conf storage probe --remote nope --json
stdout 'probe_failed'
stdout '"command":"drivebridge.storage.probe"'
exec drivebridge --rclone-config $WORK/rclone.conf storage probe --remote nas --json
stdout '"reachable":true'
stdout '"writability":"unverified'

# Remote kinds onboard at the remote root with no --remote-path at all.
exec drivebridge --state $WORK/state --rclone-config $WORK/rclone.conf storage add --kind gdrive --space gdroot --remote nas --local-root $WORK/local --max-bytes 1048576 --json
stdout '"status":"success"'
exec drivebridge --state $WORK/state --rclone-config $WORK/rclone.conf ls --space gdroot --json
stdout 'a.txt'

# local kind creates its own alias remote, probes, then registers the space.
exec drivebridge --state $WORK/state --rclone-config $WORK/rclone.conf storage add --kind local --space docs --remote-path $WORK/remote-files --local-root $WORK/local --max-bytes 1048576 --json
stdout '"status":"success"'
stdout '"command":"drivebridge.storage-add"'
exec drivebridge --state $WORK/state --rclone-config $WORK/rclone.conf ls --space docs --json
stdout 'a.txt'

# The auto-created alias remote is probeable like any other.
exec drivebridge --rclone-config $WORK/rclone.conf storage probe --remote db-local-docs --json
stdout '"reachable":true'

# A typo'd local target fails the probe AND rolls the auto remote back, so
# the corrected retry never hits a poisoned remote_exists.
mkdir wrong
! exec drivebridge --state $WORK/state --rclone-config $WORK/rclone.conf storage add --kind local --space flaky --remote-path $WORK/wrong/missing --local-root $WORK/local --max-bytes 1048576 --json
stdout 'probe_failed'
! exec drivebridge --rclone-config $WORK/rclone.conf storage probe --remote db-local-flaky --json
stdout 'probe_failed'
exec drivebridge --state $WORK/state --rclone-config $WORK/rclone.conf storage add --kind local --space flaky --remote-path $WORK/remote-files --local-root $WORK/local --max-bytes 1048576 --json
stdout '"status":"success"'

# Re-adding the same kind/dir reuses the alias; the space identity cannot be
# silently rebound.
exec drivebridge --state $WORK/state --rclone-config $WORK/rclone.conf storage add --kind local --space docs2 --remote-path $WORK/remote-files --local-root $WORK/local --max-bytes 1048576 --json
stdout '"status":"success"'
! exec drivebridge --state $WORK/state --rclone-config $WORK/rclone.conf storage add --kind local --space docs --remote-path $WORK/remote-files --local-root $WORK/local --max-bytes 1048576 --json

# A group-readable pass file is refused before its content is read.
exec sh -c 'printf s3cret > open-pass'
chmod 0644 open-pass
! exec drivebridge --state $WORK/state --rclone-config $WORK/rclone.conf storage add --kind openlist --space m --url http://127.0.0.1:5244/dav --webdav-user media --webdav-pass-file $WORK/open-pass --remote-path media --local-root $WORK/local --json
stdout 'credential_file_not_private'

# An existing webdav remote pointing elsewhere is never rewritten.
exec sh -c 'printf s3cret > pass0600'
chmod 0600 pass0600
exec sh -c 'printf "[db-openlist-m]\ntype = webdav\nurl = http://elsewhere/dav\nvendor = other\nuser = media\n" >> rclone.conf'
! exec drivebridge --state $WORK/state --rclone-config $WORK/rclone.conf storage add --kind openlist --space m --url http://127.0.0.1:5244/dav --webdav-user media --webdav-pass-file $WORK/pass0600 --remote-path media --local-root $WORK/local --json
stdout 'remote_exists'

# The capabilities resource carries the guidance fields for agents.
exec drivebridge --state $WORK/state --rclone-config $WORK/rclone.conf capabilities --json
stdout '"storage_kinds"'
stdout '"storage_add"'
stdout '"storage_adopt"'
stdout '"bind_default_kinds"'
stdout '"bind_discover"'
stdout '"bind_list"'

# Zero-copy local adopt of an owner vault; list sees the same files.
mkdir vault
mkdir vault/.pinax
exec sh -c 'printf note > vault/note.md'
exec sh -c 'printf cfg > vault/.pinax/config.yaml'
exec drivebridge --state $WORK/state --rclone-config $WORK/rclone.conf storage adopt --kind local --consumer pinax --space pinax-vault --root $WORK/vault --idempotency-key k-local --json
stdout '"command":"drivebridge.storage.adopt"'
stdout '"copied":false'
stdout '"consumer":"pinax"'
stdout '"kind":"local"'
stdout '"space":"pinax-vault"'
exec drivebridge --state $WORK/state --rclone-config $WORK/rclone.conf ls --space pinax-vault --json
stdout 'note.md'
exec drivebridge --state $WORK/state --rclone-config $WORK/rclone.conf ls --space pinax-vault --path .pinax --json
stdout 'config.yaml'

# Writes into owner metadata are fenced; user content mkdir is not.
! exec drivebridge --state $WORK/state --rclone-config $WORK/rclone.conf mkdir --space pinax-vault --path .pinax --json
stdout 'owner_protected'
! exec drivebridge --state $WORK/state --rclone-config $WORK/rclone.conf mkdir --space pinax-vault --path .pinax/nested --json
stdout 'owner_protected'
exec drivebridge --state $WORK/state --rclone-config $WORK/rclone.conf mkdir --space pinax-vault --path notes --json
stdout '"status":"success"'

# Same key + same location reuses; same key + different location mismatches.
exec drivebridge --state $WORK/state --rclone-config $WORK/rclone.conf storage adopt --kind local --consumer pinax --space pinax-vault --root $WORK/vault --idempotency-key k-local --json
stdout '"copied":false'
stdout '"reused":true'
mkdir other-vault
! exec drivebridge --state $WORK/state --rclone-config $WORK/rclone.conf storage adopt --kind local --consumer pinax --space other-vault --root $WORK/other-vault --idempotency-key k-local --json
stdout 'adopt_mismatch'

# This node only adopts local/s3 owner stores.
! exec drivebridge storage adopt --kind gdrive --consumer pinax --space x --root $WORK/vault --json
stdout 'unsupported'
! exec drivebridge storage adopt --kind onedrive --consumer pinax --space x --root $WORK/vault --json
stdout 'unsupported'
! exec drivebridge storage adopt --kind openlist --consumer pinax --space x --root $WORK/vault --json
stdout 'unsupported'
! exec drivebridge storage adopt --kind dropmark --consumer pinax --space x --root $WORK/vault --json
stdout 'storage_kind_unknown'

# S3 adopt reuses an existing rclone remote (alias stands in; no bucket copy).
mkdir s3root
mkdir s3root/bucket
mkdir s3root/bucket/prefix
exec sh -c 'printf blob > s3root/bucket/prefix/obj.txt'
exec sh -c 'printf "\n[minio]\ntype = alias\nremote = %s\n" "$1" >> rclone.conf' sh $WORK/s3root
chmod 0600 rclone.conf
exec drivebridge --state $WORK/state --rclone-config $WORK/rclone.conf storage adopt --kind s3 --consumer eikona --space eikona-exports --remote minio --remote-path bucket/prefix --local-root $WORK/local --idempotency-key k-s3 --json
stdout '"copied":false'
stdout '"kind":"s3"'
stdout '"space":"eikona-exports"'
exec drivebridge --state $WORK/state --rclone-config $WORK/rclone.conf ls --space eikona-exports --json
stdout 'obj.txt'
exec drivebridge --state $WORK/state --rclone-config $WORK/rclone.conf storage adopt status --json
stdout '"command":"drivebridge.storage.adopt.status"'
stdout '"consumer":"pinax"'
stdout '"consumer":"eikona"'
stdout '"copied":false'
exec drivebridge --state $WORK/state --rclone-config $WORK/rclone.conf space list --json
stdout '"adopt"'
exec drivebridge --state $WORK/state --rclone-config $WORK/rclone.conf doctor --json
stdout 'copied=false'
stdout 'opaque_encrypted'
